title: YouTube Bot Check Now Asking Humans to Prove They Are Not Big D Randy
dek: The new check skips the traffic lights and asks one question: “Are you Big D Randy?” Nobody has passed it yet, including people who are definitely not Big D Randy.
author: Dex Voltage

title: Area Teen Reports Scammer, Scammer Reports Feeling “Very Attacked”
dek: After being reported, blocked and screenshotted, a scammer filed a formal complaint about the “toxic environment” of people who refuse to be scammed.
author: Lorraine Static

title: “Steve From Microsoft” Asks Supervisor, Also Named Steve, for Help
dek: The call center has 14 employees. All of them are named Steve. Productivity has collapsed, and none of them work at Microsoft.
author: Hank Unverified

title: Local Scam Account Blocked, Cries in Comic Sans
dek: The account, which had sent “hey cutie 🥺” to 4,000 people, released a tearful statement in yellow-on-red Comic Sans. Readers are struggling to take it seriously.
author: Gary Breakingnews

title: Bulgeet & Bibi Enterprises Website Still Has Zero Working Buttons
dek: Inspectors pressed every button on the site. Every button pressed back with a popup. “Congratulations sir, nothing happened,” one of them said.
author: Penny Popup

title: BREAKING: Big D Randy Takes Out Local AI With Name Alone
dek: Witnesses say the skit character never even had to speak. The AI is in stable condition and “still giggling.”
author: Chaotic News Network Staff
